title: Earnings Call Transcripts Released for Venture Global and Remitly
summary: Transcripts for the Q2 2026 earnings calls of Venture Global (VG) and Remitly (RELY) have been made publicly available. Fortune released the transcript for Venture Global, while The Globe and Mail published the transcript for Remitly. These documents provide detailed financial and operational information from the companies for the second quarter of 2026.
summary_points: Venture Global (VG) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript released.
Remitly (RELY) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript released.
Fortune published the Venture Global transcript.
The Globe and Mail published the Remitly transcript.
Transcripts cover the second quarter of 2026.

summary_points_hi: वेंचर ग्लोबल (वीजी) दूसरी तिमाही 2026 अर्निंग कॉल ट्रांसक्रिप्ट जारी की गई।
